content: react-mentions v4.4.10 last published 3 years ago. React 19 compatibility unknown/untested. Do NOT use. Hand-rolled @mention is appropriate for session chat with bounded participant list (3-10 people max): detect @ trigger in textarea onChange, filter participant list by partial match, show a <ul> popover with keyboard nav. Zero dependency. tiptap/ProseMirror is heavyweight (full rich-text editor framework).
